title: Hiring app with masked CV scoring
prompt: We're hiring and I want an app to run it. I create openings with a description and must-have skills, and upload CVs as PDFs to an opening. For each CV, AI pulls out name, email, years of experience and skills, then scores the candidate 1 to 10 against that opening with a one-line reason and whether the CV shows each must-have. To keep scoring fair, the AI that scores must never see the name, email or phone number, so mask them on our side first. Candidates move through New, Screen, Interview, Offer and Rejected on a board. I can add notes and override a score, and an override sticks. Editing an opening's must-haves offers to re-score its candidates, which never touches overrides or notes. The same email applying twice to one opening merges, not duplicates. The same person in two openings keeps separate stages and scores. A stats page shows each opening's count per stage and average score, using overrides and leaving out Rejected. A chat page answers questions like 'who are the strongest Python people for Backend?' only from saved candidates, and deleting a candidate removes them from everything, including chat answers. Save everything between visits. My Anthropic key is set up. Make it and get it working.
